text.p: Ford Motor Co. said Thursday its board of directors voted to increase the automaker's quarterly dividend to 42 cents a share, from 38.5 cents previously.

Ford Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Alex Trotman said the increase, the sixth since the first quarter of 1994, reflects continued improvement in the company's operations from higher automotive margins and lower costs.
The 9 percent dividend hike applies to the automaker's Class B and common stock. The 38.5 cents amount had been paid since the third quarter of 1996.

The Ford board also declared a dividend of $1.05 a share on the depositary shares representing the company's Series A Cumulative Convertible Preferred Stock and a dividend of 51.5625 cents a share on the depositary shares representing the company's Series B Cumulative Preferred Stock.
The second-quarter dividends are payable June 2 to shareholders of record on May 2.
